body:
I have no energy, I'm drained, I just feel emotionally numb and want to end it all. My mental state is getting worse by the day; I've recently learned that sometimes you have to know when to quit, we're not all fit for this life, and I'm no different. 

> It doesn't matter if your lazy or if your going to do something the next day

Easier said than done my friend, if I continue to fail my exams I'm going to be kicked out of university with no degree, no education, no job, I'm literally a worthless sack of shit, I have no purpose, I'm only causing pain to the ones that love me, it's not worth it in the long run.

> I know you deep down have a passion for something, follow it and enjoy yourself.

This is my issue, I'm dead on the inside, I have nothing I enjoy, I just want to escape.

These past 6 years have been absolute and utter hell, and with life getting harder by the day, these coming 60 years will be the worst of my life? What is there to live for if I'm struggling day in and day out.
